nativeOwners.statusLifecycle: server/db.ts updateAdminUser; toggleAdminUserStatus delegates to it
nativeOwners.authorization: adminManageProcedure admins.manage plus original complete effective-super row lock first, then native actor+target FOR UPDATE ordered by id, then fresh actor archive/grants/sessionVersion verification; no new advisory-lock namespace
nativeOwners.revocation: adminUsers.sessionVersion SQL + 1 on actual status change
nativeOwners.audit: existing auditLogs (audit_logs), same transaction; NOT adminUserPermissionAudits
nativeOwners.frontendAndEnterprise: independent, never status-mutated by Staff account toggle

input.expectedStatus: active | disabled | locked; REQUIRED at runtime

toggleStatus.typeCompatibility: expectedStatus/reason schema fields optional plus refinement requiring them at runtime, to avoid editing out-of-scope legacy Admins.tsx. Legacy calls without baseline/reason fail BAD_REQUEST; Staff always supplies both.

genericUpdate.expectedStatus: required whenever status supplied, same runtime validation as dedicated toggle
genericUpdate.reason: required whenever status supplied; role/permissions/password-only inputs unchanged
genericUpdate.statusGuard: shared updateAdminUser transaction checks stale baseline, archive, self-disable, last effective super-admin and locked-to-active forbidden; no toggle-only bypass

constraints: No Git writes, network/SSH/production DB, schema/migration, Profile/Nav/deploy or other business source changes. Only mock/in-memory directed tests.

dbInputsActual.updateAdminUser: existing input extended with expectedStatus?, reason?, statusAudit?: MaterialAuditActor, actorSessionVersion?: number; externally reachable management routes inject authenticated actor and version
dbInputsActual.toggleAdminUserStatus: existing (id,status,actorAdminUserId?) positional contract preserved with optional fourth options {expectedStatus?,reason?,statusAudit?,actorSessionVersion?}; validates runtime via updateAdminUser
dbInputsActual.statusRuntimeRequirements: Both status paths require expectedStatus, trimmed 2..500-char reason, authenticated native actor, safe actorSessionVersion, statusAudit.operatorId. Archived targets reject all mutation; locked targets reject every ordinary status transition away from locked (including locked→disabled→active bypass).

uiActual: readonly status badge, existing h-14 row and 200px action column; compact 配置权限 | 停用/启用 | 删除; target name/username confirmation, reason, synchronous duplicate-submit gate, actor epoch guard, real adminUser.list readback; self/archive/locked and only-last-possible-active-super guarded in UI, authoritative full-set continuity server-side; an independent native list sample page=1/pageSize=100 proves >1 effective super; unavailable or insufficient sample conservatively disables active-super stop. Runtime server counts and locks every non-archived active super.
statusOnly: No-op unchanged status: no writes/audit. Actual status change: status/sessionVersion +1, generic audit and existing sales identity sync only; no password/permissions/sales scope/frontend/enterprise/ownership/archive writes. Non-status role/permissions/password cleanup path kept unchanged after shared actor guard.

auditActual.operatorNameRole: fresh locked native actor displayName/username and adminRole
auditActual.schemaReference: live-audit-schema-readonly.json supplied by parent; no migration

legacyCompatibility: Out-of-scope Admins.tsx not edited. Inferred optional expectedStatus/reason retains compilation; old baseline-free toggle is intentionally rejected BAD_REQUEST. Role/permissions/password-only update is unchanged and needs no reason.

statusWriteCAS.writeResult: MySQL result[0].affectedRows must equal exactly 1 on every actual status change; otherwise ADMIN_STATUS_CONFLICT throws before audit/projections, rolling back entire transaction
statusWriteCAS.nonStatusPath: existing id-only SQL and cleanup semantics unchanged
